messages.subject: How to connect shinyapps.io with the shiny app which is connected to local database using SQL server
parts:
I have made a sample shiny app that gets connected with the SQL Server running on my local host. I have created a free account in shinyapps.io and when I tried to deploy to it, I am getting the error "failed to load from server"

library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(RMySQL)
library(lubridate)
library(DBI)


con_iris <- DBI::dbConnect(
  drv = RMySQL::MySQL(),
  dbname = "iris_db",
  host = "localhost",
  username = "XXXX",
  password = "XXXXXX"
)



ui<-shinyUI(fluidPage(
  #fluid page for dynamically adapting to screens of different resolutions.
  titlePanel("Iris Dataset"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("select", label = h5("select species"),choices = c("setosa"=1, "Vericolor"=2, "virginica"=3), 
                  selected = 1)
                ),
    mainPanel(
      textOutput("data")
    )
  )
))

server<-shinyServer(function(input, output) {

  #referring output distPlot in ui.r as output$distPlot
  output$data <- renderText({
      query<-paste0("select * from iris where Species= '", input$select , "'", sep='')
      species<-dbGetQuery(con_iris, query)
      })
})

shinyApp(ui=ui,server=server)

Can anyone help me like what are all the procedural changes that needs to be done in the code/shinyapps.io account....to deploy the shiny app and fetch data from the sql server which is hosted locally in my machine...because i couldn't any proper steps to connect with my local server...reallly need help in this guys...!!!

parts:
Additionally, you will need to change "localhost" to a public name for your database, or it's public IP address, as there is no database running on shinyapps.io itself for you to connect to.
See the documentation on Accessing Databases with odbc
